title: A Clinical Study of Ivonescimab in Combination With Cadonilimab or Ipilimumab for Advanced Renal Cancer
official: A Phase II Clinical Study of Ivonescimab in Combination With Cadonilimab or Ipilimumab in the Treatment of Advanced Renal Cancer
summary: This study aims to evaluate the safety and efficacy of Ivonescimab alone or in combination with Cadonilimab or Ipilimumab in the treatment of advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Able to understand and voluntarily sign a written informed consent form, which must be signed prior to the performance of the designated study procedures required by the study.
2. Age ≥ 18 years both male and female.
3. Karnofsky Performance Status Score (KPS) ≥ 70%.
4. Expected survival ≥ 6 months.
5. According to RECIST v1.1, there is at least one measurable lesion that is suitable for repeated and accurate measurements.
6. Histologically or cytologically, pathologically confirmed renal cancer with a clear cell carcinoma component (ccRCC).
7. Locally advanced or metastatic RCC not amenable to curative surgery or radiotherapy.
8. Adequate organ function.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Locally advanced disease that is resectable or suitable for local therapy with curative intent.
2. Histologically or cytologically confirmed renal non-clear cell carcinoma (nccRCC).
3. Presence of active central nervous system (CNS) metastases.
4. Previous anti-tumor therapy toxicity has not been resolved.
5. Have other malignancies within 5 years prior to enrollment.
6. Known presence of active pulmonary tuberculosis and active syphilis infection.
7. Other reasons for ineligibility as evaluated by investigator.
